verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own enterprise page promises "case visibility" alongside a structured workflow, which glancingly points toward clients being able to see where their case stands. However, no portal, dashboard, status view or next-steps display is actually described. missing for 10: a documented client portal or dashboard, case status tracking details, next-steps display, founder-facing screenshots or docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product

citations.quote: LegalOS keeps preparation, attorney review, filing, and case visibility within one accountable immigration team.
LegalOS helps organize employer and candidate materials in one structured workflow.
